dimensions.query:
SELECT
    if(timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen'), 'current', 'previous') AS period,
    event,
    properties.$app_version AS version,
    properties.source AS source,
    properties.access_tier AS access_tier,
    properties.set_count_bucket AS sets,
    count() AS events,
    count(DISTINCT person_id) AS persons
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-12 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')
  AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-26 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')
  AND event IN ('workout started','workout completed','paywall shown')
  AND coalesce(toString(person.properties.internal_team), 'false') != 'true'
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_testflight), 'false') != 'true'
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_emulator), 'false') != 'true'
GROUP BY period,event,version,source,access_tier,sets
ORDER BY period,event,events DESC

program_handoff.query:
WITH entrants AS (
    SELECT person_id, min(timestamp) AS entered
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'onboarding step viewed'
      AND properties.step = 'welcome'
      AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-26 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')
      AND coalesce(toString(person.properties.internal_team), 'false') != 'true'
      AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_testflight), 'false') != 'true'
      AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_emulator), 'false') != 'true'
    GROUP BY person_id
    HAVING entered >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')
), activity AS (
    SELECT e.person_id,
        countIf(e.event = 'program selected') AS programs,
        countIf(e.event = 'template started') AS templates,
        countIf(e.event = 'workout started') AS starts,
        countIf(e.event = 'workout started' AND e.properties.source = 'empty') AS empty_starts,
        countIf(e.event = 'first set logged') AS first_sets
    FROM events e JOIN entrants c ON e.person_id = c.person_id
    WHERE e.timestamp >= c.entered
      AND e.timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')
      AND e.timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-26 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')
      AND coalesce(toString(e.person.properties.internal_team), 'false') != 'true'
      AND coalesce(toString(e.properties.$is_testflight), 'false') != 'true'
      AND coalesce(toString(e.properties.$is_emulator), 'false') != 'true'
    GROUP BY e.person_id
)
SELECT count() AS entrants, countIf(programs > 0) AS program_selectors,
    countIf(programs > 0 AND starts > 0) AS selectors_starting,
    countIf(programs > 0 AND templates > 0) AS selectors_using_templates,
    countIf(programs > 0 AND starts > 0 AND starts = empty_starts) AS selectors_only_empty,
    countIf(starts > 0) AS starters,
    countIf(starts > 0 AND first_sets = 0) AS starters_no_sets
FROM activity

weekly_overlap.query:
WITH counts AS (
SELECT person_id,
    countIf(timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')) AS previous_workouts,
    countIf(timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')) AS current_workouts
FROM events
WHERE event = 'workout completed'
  AND properties.set_count_bucket IN ('1','2-3','4-6','7-10','11+')
  AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-12 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')
  AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-26 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')
  AND coalesce(toString(person.properties.internal_team), 'false') != 'true'
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_testflight), 'false') != 'true'
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_emulator), 'false') != 'true'
GROUP BY person_id
)
SELECT previous_workouts, current_workouts, count() AS persons
FROM counts GROUP BY previous_workouts,current_workouts ORDER BY current_workouts DESC, previous_workouts DESC

query.query:
SELECT
 if(timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen'), 'current', 'previous') AS period,
 event, properties.acquisition_channel AS channel, properties.asa_conversion_type AS conversion_type,
 properties.$geoip_country_name AS country, properties.remaining_free_workouts AS remaining_free,
 count() AS events, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS persons
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-12 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')
 AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-26 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')
 AND coalesce(toString(person.properties.internal_team), 'false') != 'true'
 AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_testflight), 'false') != 'true'
 AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_emulator), 'false') != 'true'
 AND (event = 'attribution resolved' OR (event = 'workout completed' AND properties.access_tier = 'free'))
GROUP BY period,event,channel,conversion_type,country,remaining_free
ORDER BY period,event,events DESC

query.query:
WITH current_people AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT person_id
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'workout completed'
      AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00', 'Europe/Copenhagen')
      AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-26 00:00:00', 'Europe/Copenhagen')
      AND properties.set_count_bucket IN ('1','2-3','4-6','7-10','11+')
      AND coalesce(toString(person.properties.internal_team), 'false') != 'true'
      AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_testflight), 'false') != 'true'
      AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_emulator), 'false') != 'true'
), history AS (
    SELECT person_id, min(timestamp) AS first_completion,
      countIf(timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')) AS current_workouts
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'workout completed'
      AND person_id IN (SELECT person_id FROM current_people)
      AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-26 00:00:00','Europe/Copenhagen')
      AND properties.set_count_bucket IN ('1','2-3','4-6','7-10','11+')
      AND coalesce(toString(person.properties.internal_team), 'false') != 'true'
      AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_testflight), 'false') != 'true'
      AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_emulator), 'false') != 'true'
    GROUP BY person_id
)
SELECT first_completion AS first_workout_date,
 current_workouts, count() AS persons
FROM history
GROUP BY first_workout_date,current_workouts
ORDER BY current_workouts DESC,first_workout_date
